name: aMail
author: Steve Barrett
description: Agentic mail in the Omarchy bar. Every inbox you own in one hub, one MCP endpoint for your agents, and an analyzed/unanalyzed flag per message alongside read/unread. Client mode follows an aMail server you already run; server mode runs aMail here. New mail is pushed (IMAP IDLE → SSE) so the badge moves within a second.

barWidget.description: Unread and not-yet-analyzed counts across every connected mailbox. Left-click = triage panel · middle-click = refresh · right-click = open aMail.

schema.label: Show the icon when the count is zero
